rankings_daily.note: top 50 models/day plus an aggregated `other` row, back to 2025-01-01; caps at 366-day windows so the capture walks it in two

app_rankings.note: top 50 apps with tokens AND requests; honours an arbitrary date window, which is how the denominator question gets an answer. Not in the wss-openrouter registry

session_cost.note: median USD per session by app, model and turn range. Only four app_slugs are valid: claude-code, codex, kilo-code, hermes-agent

benchmarks.note: artificial-analysis, design-arena and openrouter's own. Keys on model_permaslug, exactly like the rankings, so the join is exact

classifications_task.note: 29 task classes with BOTH usage_share and token_share, plus a per-task model breakdown

models_catalog.note: CURRENT snapshot against 21 months of history, so retired models are unpriceable: 162 of 352 slugs match even after stripping the date suffix. Carries hugging_face_id on 183 of 437 rows

providers.note: 106 providers with headquarters and datacenters. Not in the wss-openrouter registry. 80 of 106 name no datacenter

hugging_face.note: 1,000 text-generation models with 30-day downloads; the bridge is models_catalog.hugging_face_id

caveats: OpenRouter is a ROUTER. It sees everyone who routes through it and nobody who calls a lab's own API directly, which is most of the industry's revenue. No sentence of the form 'lab X is winning' is supportable.
Spend is input-token LIST price on the 57% of tokens that join to a price. Completion tokens cost several times more and are not counted, and nobody large pays list.
The downloads join sees OPEN-WEIGHT models only - a closed model has no Hugging Face presence - and is 15 models, 39% of tokens.
The models catalog is a current snapshot against 21 months of history; price questions route through the benchmarks feed instead.
80 of 106 providers name no datacenter, so data-residency questions are not observable here.

Model half-life was first measured at 2 days, which was daily noise read as a peak. The published figure uses a 7-day mean, and was re-checked on absolute tokens (also 10 days) because share is relative in a market that grew 170x.
